failure.title: Ten live files required repository formatting normalization
failure.note: The retained command summary identifies the exact ten live backend, client, frontend, and verification files that failed pnpm format:check after immutable evidence had been correctly removed from the formatter's live-source scope.
failure.diagnosis: New and modified live test, source, configuration, and coverage-verification files had not all received the repository's deterministic Prettier normalization. Frozen pre-fix evidence also required an explicit generated-artifact exclusion rather than source rewriting.

rawEvidence.policy: Raw captures remain immutable in the developer-local vault; this public summary retains reviewed failure facts and cryptographic provenance without publishing browser traces, videos, logs, or mutation payloads.
